passage: You want to know if there is ever a time to break a promise, Rhea? I'll tell you one. I'm Nikita, and at twenty a friend of mine, Tanmay, sat beside me on the library steps and said he was in such deep pain he couldn't see a way through. "Promise you won't tell anyone," he said. My hands went cold. I wanted to say yes just to keep him talking. Instead I said, "I can't promise that. I care about you more than I care about the promise. But I'll tell you first, and I'll be right there with you." He was furious and didn't speak to me for two days. Then we went to the hostel warden together, and later to a doctor. Years on, he thanked me at his wedding.

qa.q: Where were Nikita and Tanmay sitting when Tanmay confided?
qa.a: They were sitting on the library steps.

qa.q: What did Nikita feel when Tanmay asked for a promise?
qa.a: Nikita's hands went cold with fear, and there was a wish to say yes just to keep Tanmay talking, yet Nikita cared more about Tanmay's safety than the promise.

qa.q: What did Nikita do that is worth copying?
qa.a: Nikita told Tanmay first, stayed with him, and went with him to the hostel warden and later a doctor.

qa.q: How might Tanmay have felt when Nikita would not promise?
qa.a: Furious and perhaps betrayed, since he did not speak to Nikita for two days, though years later he was thankful.

grounding: A friend confides deep pain and asks for secrecy; the protagonist puts safety over the promise, tells him first and involves a trusted adult and doctor.

passage:
Wednesday, 11 pm

Jeevan and I sat on the roof after dinner, like always. Then he told me he's been in so much pain since his father's death that some nights he doesn't want to be here anymore. He made me promise not to tell anyone. I'm Kishore, and my whole body went cold.

I didn't promise. I said, "Jeevan, I love you, and I can't keep this one to myself. Your safety matters more than a promise. I'm telling you first so it's not behind your back." He was angry for a minute. Then he cried.

I asked who he trusts most. His elder brother. We called him together, right there on the roof. His brother drove over from the other side of town, and they're sleeping at his place tonight. Tomorrow at ten they're seeing a doctor. I'll call Jeevan at breakfast.

qa.q: Where were Jeevan and Kishore sitting?
qa.a: They were sitting on the roof after dinner.

qa.q: What was Kishore feeling when Jeevan asked for the promise, and how can you tell?
qa.a: Kishore felt frightened and shaken, with the whole body going cold at hearing how much pain Jeevan was in.

qa.q: What would you advise someone in Kishore's place, based on what Kishore did?
qa.a: Kishore refused the secret, told Jeevan first, and called Jeevan's elder brother together with him, so an adult was involved that night.

qa.q: How might Jeevan have felt when Kishore refused the promise?
qa.a: Jeevan felt angry at first, then cried, perhaps also relieved that someone took his pain seriously enough to act.

grounding: The diary shows a young person whose friend confides deep pain and asks for secrecy, putting safety first, telling the friend and involving a trusted adult the same night.

passage:
Omkar: can I tell you something. but you have to promise not to tell anyone
Uma: I'm listening. what's going on
Omkar: I've been really not okay. like, for weeks. I feel like I'm drowning and I keep thinking everyone would be better without me
Omkar: please don't tell my parents or anyone
Uma: Omkar, thank you for telling me. I'm really glad you did
Uma: I care about you too much to keep this completely secret. I'm telling you first, honestly
Uma: can I call you right now?

Uma called and kept him talking, gently, until he agreed. With Omkar still on the line, she messaged his hostel warden, who went to his room within ten minutes. The warden sat with Omkar while he spoke to a helpline counsellor, and arranged for him to see the college doctor first thing in the morning. Uma stayed on the phone until the warden arrived.

qa.a: The warden went to his room within ten minutes.

qa.a: Uma thanked him, refused to keep it secret, told him first, called him and got the warden to him that same night while staying on the line.
